authorisation: Local creation and thorough review, then publish after all required checks.
constructionGate: Policy1.0. Stage1 module map, M101 block/unit outlines, complete Block3 lesson blueprint and released U08–U11 inspected. Full question/subpart plan established before drafting.
cumulative: Algebra, function domains, differentiation and one-sided derivatives (U04–U07), elementary trigonometry; no later module prerequisite.

questions.scope: Piecewise accumulation formula, extrema, continuity and one-sided derivative at jump; U08 and cumulative U04–U06.
Elementary power rewriting; definite substitution; logarithm integration by parts and derivative check; reject invalid FTC across singularity; U08/U09.
Displacement and final position; distance and average speed; mean velocity attained and conditions; U10/U08.
Circular slice tank capacity, nonuniform inflow interpolation, mean rate and constant calibration offset; U10/U11.
Hand benchmark, independent midpoint/trapezoid routines, refinement/reversal/zero checks, oscillatory misleading agreement, reproducibility; U11.

boundary: No improper integration evaluation, Simpson rule, derivative error-bound theorem, ODE, advanced packages or new physical laws. No threshold, weight, deadlines, enrolment or records altered.
mediaPlan: USGS constant-head tank photograph for capacity/flow setting, subject to actual rights/assets verification; original tank slice diagram with given dimensions. No answer-generating interactive; plain table sufficient for independent coding.
privacy: Worked marking guide, criterion allocations, model code and result-bearing checks stay in restricted sibling work/m101-tma03-private, outside public checkout and build.
delivery: Public questions/criteria and self-contained offline HTML; private worked guide and model code. Existing private tutoring handover retained.
workloadLimits: Editorial estimate, not student timing data. Includes reading, independent attempts, checking, rerun and packaging; feedback after marking uses existing module feedback allocation.
